profile.jobTitle: AI Code Analyst / Software Engineer (Quality Assurance Engineer)
profile.summary:
https://github.com/alyssajohns-pixel/alyssa-software-engineering-portfolio                                                                  Software Engineer, AI Code Analyst, and AI Model Evaluator specializing in software quality, LLM evaluation, technical content and code assessment, and human-in-the-loop alignment workflows. Experienced in analyzing AI-generated code, pull requests, commit messages, technical explanations, documentation, reasoning, and instruction-following against source code, tests, and repository evidence. Skilled in tracing dependencies, behavioral impact, edge cases, and failure modes across Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, C#, and C++ codebases while identifying hallucinations, unsupported claims, logic gaps, and technical inaccuracies. Experienced in prompt engineering, benchmark design, rubric-based evaluation, A/B comparison, and developing structured quality standards that improve model accuracy, software reliability, and technical communication.                                                                           
Core areas of expertise:
• Software engineering and AI-assisted code analysis
• Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, C#, and C++
• AI-generated code, pull request, and commit evaluation
• Code diff, dependency, edge-case, and failure-mode analysis
• Software testing, test-result validation, and quality assurance• Git/GitHub, YAML, JSON, and repository workflows
• Human-in-the-loop alignment and model evaluation
• LLM response assessment and preference ranking
• Prompt engineering for complex AI workflows
• AI benchmark, rubric, and acceptance-criteria design
• Hallucination detection, fact-checking, and source validation
• Technical documentation and developer-facing communication
• Instruction-following and reasoning quality analysis• A/B comparison and rubric-based scoring
• Technical accuracy, consistency, completeness, and usability review

positions.title: AI Code Analyst / Software Engineer (Quality Assurance Engineer)
positions.description:
Large-scale AI code-quality project:
• Evaluate AI-generated pull requests, commit messages, and technical descriptions against source code, code diffs, tests, and repository evidence.
• Analyze changes across Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, C#, and C++ codebases to identify change intent, behavioral impact, dependencies, edge cases, failure modes, and testing scope.
• Trace logic across source files and configuration artifacts, including YAML and JSON, to validate technical claims and identify unsupported, incomplete, or misleading descriptions.
• Perform software quality assurance and technical review by comparing AI-generated outputs against actual implementation behavior and test evidence.
• Score competing AI-generated technical outputs for accuracy, readability, faithfulness, and completeness using structured evaluation criteria.
• Rewrite pull-request descriptions, commit messages, and change summaries into concise, repository-ready technical communication.
• Produce developer-facing documentation, release-note content, application-level summaries, and actionable review feedback.
positions.insights: Skills: Code Review · Software Quality Assurance · Technical Writing · Large Language Models (LLM) · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Source Code Analysis · Technical Documentation · Prompt Engineering · Git · Python (Programming Language) · Quality Control · Editing

positions.title: Prompt Engineer | AI Task Designer | Manager I
positions.description:
Design multimodal training datasets that teach AI systems how to interact with professional software tools through structured human demonstrations.

Create high-quality screen recordings demonstrating expert workflows across audio and technical software environments, enabling AI agents to learn interface navigation, tool selection, and task execution strategies.

Develop realistic task scenarios modeling real-world software usage, including structured sequences involving creation, modification, and export of digital outputs.

Apply human-in-the-loop methodologies to produce consistent, reproducible workflow demonstrations supporting supervised fine-tuning and multimodal agent training.

Structure demonstrations to highlight decision logic, tool relationships, and procedural task completion patterns across professional software ecosystems.

Evaluate demonstration quality against defined rubric criteria emphasizing workflow clarity, progression, and successful task completion.

Contribute interaction datasets supporting development of autonomous AI agents capable of executing complex tool-based workflows.

Ensure alignment with dataset standards, reproducibility requirements, and licensing guidelines for AI training data.

Support iterative dataset improvement through structured refinement of workflow demonstrations and task clarity.

Collaborate within specialized software domain pods to produce calibrated, high-consistency training examples aligned with evolving multimodal model capabilities.

positions.title: AI Prompt Engineer Writer | Content Analyst (LLM Trainer)
positions.description:
•	Evaluated and moderated high-volume AI-generated content (1K+ outputs/week) for quality, safety, and policy alignment
•	Designed and optimized prompts, improving content accuracy and instruction adherence by ~20–30% across key tasks
•	Analyzed large-scale datasets of model outputs to identify trends, risks, and performance gaps
•	Delivered actionable insight reports that informed content strategy and model improvements
•	Conducted root cause analysis on content failures (hallucinations, bias), reducing recurring errors
•	Executed A/B testing experiments, increasing selection of high-quality outputs and consistency
•	Built and labeled datasets used to train AI systems on tone, clarity, and moderation standards
•	Collaborated cross-functionally to refine content guidelines and improve user-facing experiences

Excelled as a freelance journalist for Madamenoire.com, Newsmakerslive.com and the Atlanta Voice Newspaper.

Researched extensively and crafted engaging, informative articles that resonated with readers and maintained high engagement levels.

Demonstrated strong AP-style writing and reporting skills, crafting and editing engaging content for diverse audiences.

Verified the accuracy of information through meticulous fact-checking processes to ensure credibility and reliability.

Conducted in-depth research on various topics to gather relevant and up-to-date information for stories.

Successfully met tight deadlines for article submissions, consistently delivering high-quality content on schedule.

Conducted interviews with sources to obtain first-hand information and unique perspectives for articles.

Promoted published articles through strategic use of social media platforms to increase readership and visibility.

Adapted writing style to fit the voice and tone of different publications, ensuring consistency and reader appeal.

Collaborated with editors and fellow writers to refine content and maintain editorial standards.

projects.title: Code Review Risk API | Software Engineering Portfolio - https://github.com/alyssajohns-pixel/alyssa-software-engineering-portfolio
projects.description: Built a Python-based code analysis API that evaluates multi-file code changes and produces deterministic quality and risk signals. Developed with FastAPI and Pydantic, with AST-based source analysis, dependency inspection, structured findings, automated unit and API integration tests, Docker containerization, Docker Compose, and GitHub Actions CI/CD. Designed the project using modular application architecture with separate API, domain model, analysis, and service layers.
